{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wide-leg trousers, high-waisted, full length, deep burgundy (#6B2737), soft crepe

Fitted knit top, fine-gauge, long sleeves, boat neckline, hip-skimming length, warm ivory (#F2E8D5), merino wool

Textured blazer, softly tailored, single-breasted, hip length, olive-taupe (#8A8060), wool bouclé

Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, cognac (#A0612F), smooth leather

Small structured shoulder bag, chocolate brown (#4A3426), leather

Drop earrings, small, antique gold (#B08D57), metal

Thin leather belt, slim gold buckle, cognac (#A0612F), leather

Why this outfit works: The neat band for an autumn evening date at a casual restaurant calls for polish without stiffness, and the soft knit with a textured blazer and tailored trousers delivers exactly that. Burgundy, ivory and olive-taupe are warm, rich colors that harmonize with your golden skin, brown hair and olive-green eyes, and the ivory near your face brightens your look under restaurant lighting. The high waist and the belt define your waistline, while the wide leg adds an elegant, flowing line. The blazer keeps you comfortable on a cool November evening, and the cognac boots and gold accents tie the look together warmly."}
